item.Q: What does なるべく express, and how does it differ from できるだけ?
item.A: A reasonable effort, "as much as possible, where you can". できるだけ means the same but is a little stronger: to the limit of one's ability.

item.Q: {{c1::なるべく::adverb}}早く返事をください。
item.A: Please reply as soon as you can.

item.Q: 夜はなるべく甘いものを{{c1::食べないようにしている}}。
item.A: I try not to eat sweets at night, as far as I can.
